purpose: Teach: ウキウキ/なんにも/おこる/ひと時/概して/めんどう/こまかい/やむを得ず

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏休み前でウキウキしてんな
lines.en: Riku, you're getting all excited about summer break, aren't you?
lines.style: Teasing warmth. Light, quick delivery on the opening. Playful recognition — she's caught him in something genuine. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、いつも、なんにも考えてないだろ、桜
lines.en: You're one to talk. You never think about anything anyway, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection, almost a smile underneath. Quick parry — defending himself without making it serious. Self-aware but not apologetic.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト悪いと先生がおこるぞ
lines.en: Your test scores are going to be rough if you keep that up. The teacher's going to have your head.
lines.style: Sharp concern disguised as mockery. Faster pace — she cares and it makes her blunt. The warning of someone who'd actually worry.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後のひと時、いつも俺と過ごしてるな、桜
lines.en: But you spend your free time after school with me every day anyway, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost a question. Soft attack. He's calling out what matters without making it loud. Steady eye contact underneath the casual words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、概して真面目だな
lines.en: You know, for someone so lazy on the surface, you're actually pretty serious about things.
lines.style: Recognition softer than her usual tone. Slower — she's admitting something true. Slight smile. Not quite meeting his eyes because she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題めんどうって言うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't even try to tell me you hate cram school. We both know why you actually go.
lines.style: Knowing, with an edge of teasing. Quick delivery on the first half. Lets the implication hang — she sees through him. Slight challenge underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、こまかい所までこだわるよな
lines.en: The way you focus on every little detail though — you really do care about things more than you let on.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, slightly slower than her normal pace. Not performed. The words land like she's been thinking about it. Vulnerable for a moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾は、やむを得ず行ってんだろ?桜
lines.en: You pretend cram school's a drag, but come on — you obviously feel obligated to at least try, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry knowingness, warmly skeptical. Light at the start, then settles into something more perceptive. He's figured something out. Slight smirk in the delivery.
